Launch design may however be informed and or influenced by outcomes of the Social Screening

and Consultations following the preliminary Social and Environmental Impact Assessment

conducted at the potential project sites. These impact assessments included consultations with

various stakeholders and potential PAPs and provide environmental characteristics as well as

preliminary indicators of demography; land tenure; socio-economic status of some Potential

PAPs. Preliminary household surveys conducted contain general household data such as: family

size, gender and age information; education; occupation; land ownership in at least four of the

potential project sites and in addition to this data at these four possible project sites; average
